C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES-DOCX.IntentSummary: Draft plan for the approved verification-scoped spec C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES-DOCX, authored on worktree green-w5b (branch spec/export-consent-docx) rebased on fork/main 638c0a7c; the active drafts on this base are C-47 and C-50 plus this change (verified in .grace/changes/active/). Honest provenance: every spec-cited code anchor was re-verified byte-exact at its current line on 2026-11-25 — exportImages.js START_BLOCK_SCOPE_GATE :135-153 with the pure classifier :142 and the two-phase embedLocalImages :177-283 (the single awaited requestScopeConsent :226, the declined keep-src/skip branch :235, the count-only markers :223/:271-274), exportHtml.js countPlantUMLFences :112-139, plantUMLSourcePlaceholder :144-146, the plantuml consent branch :249-262 and the options-key read :377, plantuml.js PLANTUML_URL :4 and the src build :54, editor.vue requestScopeConsent :2327 and requestPlantUMLExportConsent :2365 with the dedupKeys :2338/:2376, the styledHtml raise-embed-notice sequence :2539-2577, the docx twin :2599-2628 and the pdf/print corner C-12 comments :2668-2672/:2707-2710, m031_diff.rs SecurityCtx command :54-58, the check_path fence :74-80, the regular-file gate :83-91, the MAX_READ_BYTES cap :94-100, the strict UTF-8 read :104-105 and the five sandbox fixtures :247-333, plus the four e2e files and the unit files at their cited ranges. One drift found against the spec text: the M-066 Dependencies line sits at :3023 in .grace/graph/features.xml (the spec cites :3022) — a one-line offset from the rebase with no content drift; every other anchor is byte-exact at the line the spec cites. Scope discipline: zero production code changes — the three boundaries are delivered and frozen by archived applied C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES (embed scope gate, PlantUML export consent, the m031 sidecar fence) and wrapped by archived applied C-EXPORT-DOCUMENT-PIN; the genuinely open layer is the one above the unit pins. The embed-consent card is mounted by NO e2e file today (the export-html-images fixture lives entirely inside the document directory :25-32/:44-60, so the card can never fire, and the artifact assertions :86-96 never see an out-of-scope reference), the PlantUML card's only e2e mount (export-document-pin.spec.ts :64-71) drives it purely inside the pin-refusal and consented-identity scenarios, and no saved artifact is ever asserted to carry a declined out-of-directory src, the pre.ag-plantuml-export-source placeholder, a granted-set embed or exactly-one plantuml.com reference. The plan closes exactly that gap: ten artifact pins, five per door, driving documents with an out-of-directory image (plus the in-scope sibling) or exactly one ```plantuml fence through the real renderer and the real notification-stack buttons into the saved-artifact doubles — the mt_fs_write capture on the html door, the mt_fs_write_binary ZIP double unpacked with JSZip on the docx door. Test-file layout decision (exactly one layout chosen, per the spec's either/or): the EXTENDED PAIR — tests/e2e/export-html-images.spec.ts and tests/e2e/export-office.spec.ts each gain one new consent describe beside the existing ones; no tests/e2e/export-consent.spec.ts is created — because the spec's Goals word both doors as extends, the html file's PNG fixture bytes and per-path stat/read mock pattern (:22-60) are reused verbatim by the embed pins, the docx file's JSZip unpacking (:181-189) is reused verbatim, and the V-M-065/V-M-066 Commands lines already name both files, so the verification delta stays scenario-only with zero command churn. Red-first accounting is honest per the spec: this change's reds are coverage reds — the behavior reds belong to archived C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES' failing-first evidence — and the coverage red is mechanically enforced by the baseline MustNotContain entries (both e2e files contain zero occurrences of "consent", of this change's id and of ag-plantuml-export-source today) with the command tails recorded in the bundle evidence.json; a NEW pin found red on the current tree at implementation time is by definition a regression discovery stopping the change for re-scope, never an assertion to adapt. Hold-green (T-003) keeps the m031 sandbox matrix, the diff-view renderer failure surface and every predecessor export suite green unweakened — no verification delta for (c). Governance (T-004): .grace/verification/features.xml carries V-M-065/V-M-066 scenario deltas only, each naming the new evidence and its playwright command; the R-4 decision is recorded as NO contract-visible addition, so .grace/graph/features.xml is untouched (the M-065/M-066 contracts already state the gates, and the M-066 Dependencies post-consent-consumer note sits at :3023), no runtime.xml edit, no locale edit (the cards' copy exists in all ten locales, pinned by the ten-locale describe :743-805), and no MustVerify entry appears anywhere in this plan because no graph delta exists. Zero production-code change is mechanically enforced by target MustNotContain entries pinning this change's id absent from every production file, from the graph and from the locales. No grace-lint command appears inside this plan — lint runs only in the external target/final phases. Execution mode: T-001..T-004 strictly sequential, single-writer; each door task captures its coverage-red evidence BEFORE authoring that file's pins; consent decisions resolve through the real notification-stack buttons; no test depends on plantuml.com or any network being reachable (the consented remote-img form is pinned as the src string the offline renderer builds, plantuml.js :54); the export pin rides its happy path (one stable document per test), and pin-refusal interplay stays C-EXPORT-DOCUMENT-PIN's own covered ground.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Coverage-red capture FIRST, on the pre-change tree, before any authoring: grep -c over tests/e2e/export-html-images.spec.ts proves zero occurrences of "consent", of C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES-DOCX and of ag-plantuml-export-source (the existing fixture lives entirely inside the document directory :25-32/:44-60 and the artifact assertions :86-96 never see an out-of-scope reference, so no consent-formed artifact is asserted anywhere in the file); the command tails are recorded in .grace/changes/active/C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES-DOCX/evidence.json as this change's red evidence — coverage reds only, the behavior reds belong to archived applied C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES' failing-first evidence (spec criterion a accounting).

The document carries an in-directory sibling image (img/shot.png answered by the established stat/read doubles :44-60 with PNG_BYTES) AND an out-of-directory absolute image (/tmp/html-flow-outside/secret.png whose stat/read mocks answer only that exact path with a DISTINCT fixture byte array, so byte identity proves the right file's bytes).
